mapper.insert: INSERT INTO baseline_summary (host_id, task_id, pass_count, fail_count, score, compliance_rate, last_scan_time) VALUES (#{hostId}, #{taskId}, #{passCount}, #{failCount}, #{score}, #{complianceRate}, #{lastScanTime}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE pass_count = #{passCount}, fail_count = #{failCount}, score = #{score}, compliance_rate = #{complianceRate}, last_scan_time = #{lastScanTime}
